asset_balance.strong_development: >=250 signals per BTC/ETH/SOL and no single asset dominates P&L
asset_balance.weak: >=25 signals per BTC/ETH/SOL and no asset below 25% of signals when feasible

horizon_requirements.180s: >=80% where time-to-expiry permits; otherwise tag as short-horizon stratum

replay_requirements: paper-only simulator reproducible from stored public evidence

side_balance.moderate: >=100 signals per YES/NO and no side below 35%
side_balance.strong_development: >=350 signals per YES/NO and positive stressed expectancy on both sides
side_balance.weak: >=35 signals per YES/NO and no side below 30% of signals
